fact: South Sudan's Directorate of Civil Registry, Nationality, Passport and Immigration says it is planning to digitise civil registration and link it with the national ID system, with Justice, Interior and Health ministries involved, per Biometric Update.

The Directorate General of Civil Registry, Nationality, Passport and Immigration handles civil registration and issues national identity cards, so one body holds both functions (Eye Radio report of the handover).
system: Directorate General of Civil Registry, Nationality, Passport and Immigration

fact: The Directorate of Civil Registry, Nationality, Passports and Immigration is to issue birth certificates through a new nationwide digital registry and also to introduce digital national ID cards for citizens 18 and over, as its Director General says.
